biography:
Maro Engel, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and apprehension in racing paddocks, hails from a small, quiet village nestled in the Black Forest. His introduction to motorsport wasn't through the usual karting route; instead, it was the roar of his grandfather's vintage Porsche 911 tearing through the mountain roads that ignited his passion. He entered a local hill climb at the age of 16, stunning seasoned veterans with his raw talent and fearless driving. That audacious debut led to a scholarship in a junior formula series. 

Engel quickly climbed the ranks, his aggressive style often pushing his machinery, and sometimes his rivals, to the limit. A defining moment came during a rain-soaked race at the Nürburgring where, despite starting near the back of the grid, he carved his way through the field, executing daring overtakes in treacherous conditions to secure a podium finish. Now, at 21, Engel is making waves with the Mercedes-AMG team, his youthful exuberance tempered by a growing understanding of race craft and strategy, though the fiery spirit of his early days remains undimmed. He still has much to learn, but his raw speed and unwavering determination suggest a bright future on the horizon. 

His recent switch to GT racing was initially met with skepticism, but Engel quickly proved his versatility, adapting his aggressive driving style to the demands of endurance racing. He still dreams of Formula 1, viewing GT racing as a stepping stone to prove his mettle and attract the attention of the right people.
drivingStyle: Engel's driving style is best described as a controlled explosion. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often leaves rivals scrambling to keep up, but he's not reckless. He possesses an uncanny ability to find the limit of grip and dance right on the edge, extracting every last ounce of performance from his car. While his tire management skills are still a work in progress, his raw pace and willingness to take risks in crucial moments often compensate for any minor shortcomings. He thrives under pressure, his aggression intensifying when the stakes are highest. A true racer at heart, Engel embodies the 'win-or-bust' mentality.

rivalries.reason: Clashed multiple times on track in Formula 3, their contrasting driving styles (Rossi smooth and calculated, Engel aggressive and instinctive) often leading to dramatic encounters.
Tanaka, a seasoned veteran, publicly criticized Engel's aggressive driving after a controversial incident at Spa, sparking a heated war of words and fueling intense competition on the track.
Both German drivers in the same racing series, constantly battling for the top spot. A national rivalry with high stakes.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky driving gloves, even if they are falling apart.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right before every race to get pumped up.
Has a pre-race ritual of sketching a small race track layout on his hand.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing boundaries and taking calculated risks. Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Nürburgring 24 Hours in his first attempt, showcasing his ability to handle pressure and navigate challenging conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Macau Grand Prix after a misjudged overtaking attempt, costing him a significant victory.
